assumptions: wall friction mu = 0.3 (assumed; no source in the repository, 確かめていない)
a beam element breaks (is removed) when the plastic hinge rotation at one of its ends passes 60 deg (assumed; no source in the repository, 確かめていない)

the frame split at 66.2 ms when tower_post_RA2 broke: a piece with 4.6 % of the whole mass came apart from the occupants' seat mount nodes (LS1, LS2, RS1, RS2) (the run stops at a piece of 3 % or more, HIRAKU's choice, no source). K2 has no contact between the pieces (the rest would pass through it), so the run stops there: peak_decel is up to the split, crush_at_split is the crush then (not the final crush), and mean_decel, max_crush, occupant_space_margin and occupant_space_left are not computed (the vehicle had not stopped)
smaller pieces broken off the seats' side, run on without contact with the rest: at 14.0 ms, 5 nodes (1.5 % of the mass: cross_F)
hot_spots: each frame member's least room (over the run, up to the split) to an occupant part box, read as occupant_space_left (the place's occupant_space_margin)

part boxes past the wall face, taken as crushed against it (the boxes have no contact; they move with their carried_by nodes): wheel_FL 222.6 mm, wheel_FR 221.8 mm, damper_FL 159.6 mm, damper_FR 158.8 mm, lca_FL_f 154.1 mm, lca_FR_f 153.3 mm, uca_FL_f 94.4 mm, uca_FR_f 93.6 mm, front_body 56.2 mm, fit_front_body_tower_post_LA1 46.6 mm, fit_front_body_tower_post_RA1 46.6 mm, lca_FL_r 34.1 mm, lca_FR_r 33.3 mm, fit_front_body_cross_F 15.0 mm

member_axial_force.<member> (N, + tension): of the member's elements not broken then, the axial force E A / L0 (length - L0 - plastic elongation) of the largest size, 0 when all are broken; member_hinge.<member>.<end node> (deg): the plastic hinge rotation sqrt(theta_y^2 + theta_z^2) at that end of the member; both at the node_motion field's frames

the frame as 166 co-rotational 3-D beam elements on 156 nodes (each member in up to 4 elements, none shorter than 3.5 radii of gyration of its section), explicit central differences, time step 6.19 us = 0.8 (Courant factor) x the elements' stable step 2 / omega_max; the rotational inertia of the nodes scaled up to at least (element mass / 2) x length^2 / 12 per element end (rotational mass scaling: no translational mass is added)

elastic-perfectly plastic: axial yield at A f_y, plastic hinges at the element ends at M_p = Z_p f_y about each local axis on its own, reduced by the axial force as M_p (1 - (N / N_p)^2), torsion capped at the plastic torque; the plastic deformation stays (no spring back); no strain hardening, no strain-rate effect, no local buckling of the tube walls (a tube squashes at A f_y instead of folding progressively)

mass 646.2 kg: frame 58.8 kg on its element nodes, parts 587.4 kg; the parts without carried_by (wheels, suspension) as point masses at their nearest support's frame node: RL 24.7 kg at LB, RR 24.7 kg at RB, FL 22.9 kg at LA, FR 22.9 kg at RA; each part's mass in equal shares on its carried_by nodes, as point masses (the part's own rotational inertia and its stiffness are not in the model; it moves with those nodes); section capacities: plastic moduli (K0 frame_inputs.plastic_modulus), plastic torque 2 A_m t fy / sqrt 3

the wall: a rigid plane x = 415 mm, at the front-most of the frame's nodes (LF, RF, cross_F~1, cross_F~2, cross_F~3, x = 400 mm) and the part boxes they carry; contact of the nodes only, by a penalty spring 1 x the node's mass / dt^2; the part boxes, the wheels and the bumper do not touch the wall, and the frame's pieces do not touch each other (a broken-off piece does not push on the rest)
no gravity and no ground (the crash forces are many times the weight over the run)
peak_decel and the deceleration series: the wall's impulse over each 1 ms / (the total mass x 1 ms), recorded every 0.1 ms; mean_decel: the speed lost / the time to the stop
max_crush: the shortening of the x distance from the front-most nodes back to the occupants' seat mount nodes (LS1, LS2, RS1, RS2)

occupant_space_left: the occupant part boxes move with their carried_by nodes; the least x distance over the run from the structure ahead of a box (mesh nodes and element middles inside the box's y-z extent, ahead of its rear face) back to the box's front face; negative: the structure is inside the box
run: a piece with 4.6 % of the mass broke off the seats' side (at least 3 %: the pieces have no contact, so the rest would pass through it) at 66.2 ms (10704 steps); speed at the end 2.75 m/s
occupant_space_left at the start: 45 mm (the least over the run at 66.2 ms)
battery_mount_force: the battery's mass share on each of its carried_by nodes x the node's acceleration averaged over 1 ms (largest at 7.3 ms)
first yield at 1.39 ms
first break at 13.67 ms (rail_R_FA)
the largest crush at 66.2 ms
